justifications.title: JUSTIFICATIONS
justifications.tooltip: Juries are randomly selected from all available jurors. Sometimes, the same juror may be selected more than once for the same case, and in that case, they receive more than one vote. This mechanism increases the likelihood that the most active and committed jurors will participate and strengthens the protection against arbitrary decisions.
